lines.t: Yeah… the thoughts of your heart...
Vanity’s a rope, pride builds the gallows,
Chasing that shine, but the soul feels hollow.
Envy creeps slow like smoke in my lane,
Jealousy ignites that internal flame.
Every thought you feed becomes your guide,
Whispers of ego pulling you inside.
Catch your breath, don’t lose your way,
Let your mind rise above the fray.
Beware the thoughts of your heart,
That spark might pull you apart.
Truth still shines when the lights grow dark,
Keep your rhythm, guard your spark.
Haman’s fall was pride untamed,
Cain’s path burned, his brother’s name.
History speaks in the pain we feel,
Love’s the weapon that starts to heal.
Hands up, feel the pulse ignite,
Don’t let good dance with evil tonight.
Beware the thoughts of your heart,
Hold on before you depart.
Rise in rhythm, rewrite your art,
It all begins in the heart.
Yeah… the thoughts of your heart...
Yeah… the thoughts of your heart...
